notes: A real DeepSeek Harness session enters working and binds its live PID before SIGKILL. The process exit must belong to that same session, and no ready, waiting, or error transition may occur first. Exact transcript assertions require a durable turn/start and forbid turn/end, so an unexpectedly completed idle turn cannot satisfy the lifecycle phases. Metric observations are omitted because the kill can occur before assistant usage becomes durable.
